choose.when: select t.type_id as id, t.type_name as name, ifnull(x.c1, 0) as refCount, if(ifnull(x.c1, 0) > 0, concat(ifnull(x.c1, 0), ' 间病房'), '') as detail from cat_ward_type t left join (select ward_type_id, count(1) c1 from cat_ward where del_flag = '0' group by ward_type_id) x on x.ward_type_id = t.type_id where t.type_id in #{id}

select t.tag_id as id, t.tag_name as name, ifnull(x.c1, 0) as refCount, if(ifnull(x.c1, 0) > 0, concat(ifnull(x.c1, 0), ' 只猫咪'), '') as detail from cat_tag t left join (select pt.tag_id, count(1) c1 from cat_profile_tag pt join cat_profile p on p.cat_id = pt.cat_id and p.del_flag = '0' group by pt.tag_id) x on x.tag_id = t.tag_id where t.tag_id in #{id}

select t.category_id as id, t.category_name as name, ifnull(x.c1, 0) as refCount, if(ifnull(x.c1, 0) > 0, concat(ifnull(x.c1, 0), ' 条费用'), '') as detail from cat_fee_category t left join (select category_id, count(1) c1 from cat_expense where del_flag = '0' group by category_id) x on x.category_id = t.category_id where t.category_id in #{id}

select t.category_id as id, t.category_name as name, ifnull(x.c1, 0) as refCount, if(ifnull(x.c1, 0) > 0, concat(ifnull(x.c1, 0), ' 种物资'), '') as detail from cat_material_category t left join (select category_id, count(1) c1 from cat_material where del_flag = '0' group by category_id) x on x.category_id = t.category_id where t.category_id in #{id}

select a.adoption_id as id, concat(ifnull(p.cat_name, '未知猫咪'), ' · ', ifnull(date_format(a.adoption_date, '%Y-%m-%d'), '')) as name, ifnull(x.c1, 0) as refCount, if(ifnull(x.c1, 0) > 0, concat(ifnull(x.c1, 0), ' 条回访计划'), '') as detail from cat_adoption a left join cat_profile p on p.cat_id = a.cat_id left join (select adoption_id, count(1) c1 from cat_visit group by adoption_id) x on x.adoption_id = a.adoption_id where a.adoption_id in #{id}

select pr.prescription_id as id, concat(ifnull(p.cat_name, '未知猫咪'), ' · ', ifnull(date_format(pr.start_date, '%Y-%m-%d'), '')) as name, (ifnull(i.c1, 0) + ifnull(m.c1, 0)) as refCount, concat_ws('、', if(ifnull(i.c1, 0) > 0, concat(ifnull(i.c1, 0), ' 条处方明细'), null), if(ifnull(m.c1, 0) > 0, concat(ifnull(m.c1, 0), ' 条关联用药'), null)) as detail from cat_prescription pr left join cat_profile p on p.cat_id = pr.cat_id left join (select prescription_id, count(1) c1 from cat_prescription_item group by prescription_id) i on i.prescription_id = pr.prescription_id left join (select prescription_id, count(1) c1 from cat_medication where del_flag = '0' group by prescription_id) m on m.prescription_id = pr.prescription_id where pr.prescription_id in #{id}

select d.diagnosis_id as id, concat(ifnull(p.cat_name, '未知猫咪'), ' · ', ifnull(date_format(d.visit_date, '%Y-%m-%d'), '')) as name, (ifnull(i.c1, 0) + ifnull(m.c1, 0) + ifnull(v.c1, 0) + ifnull(w.c1, 0)) as refCount, concat_ws('、', if(ifnull(i.c1, 0) > 0, concat(ifnull(i.c1, 0), ' 条检查明细'), null), if(ifnull(m.c1, 0) > 0, concat(ifnull(m.c1, 0), ' 条关联用药'), null), if(ifnull(v.c1, 0) > 0, concat(ifnull(v.c1, 0), ' 条关联疫苗'), null), if(ifnull(w.c1, 0) > 0, concat(ifnull(w.c1, 0), ' 条关联驱虫'), null)) as detail from cat_diagnosis d left join cat_profile p on p.cat_id = d.cat_id left join (select diagnosis_id, count(1) c1 from cat_diagnosis_item group by diagnosis_id) i on i.diagnosis_id = d.diagnosis_id left join (select diagnosis_id, count(1) c1 from cat_medication where del_flag = '0' group by diagnosis_id) m on m.diagnosis_id = d.diagnosis_id left join (select diagnosis_id, count(1) c1 from cat_vaccine where del_flag = '0' group by diagnosis_id) v on v.diagnosis_id = d.diagnosis_id left join (select diagnosis_id, count(1) c1 from cat_deworm where del_flag = '0' group by diagnosis_id) w on w.diagnosis_id = d.diagnosis_id where d.diagnosis_id in #{id}
choose.otherwise: select 1 as id, '' as name, 0 as refCount, '' as detail from dual where 1 = 0
